title: Naturality of the finite projection on its full input domains
statement: For any finite operation stage S [def-sf-operation-stages], any morphism f and compactification c, the component [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] is natural in every morphism a:K→K' of bounded constructible first inputs and b:L→L' of finite-Tor constructible second inputs. The source action is tensor of support(a) followed by tensor(b); the target action is support applied to tensor(a) followed by tensor(pull(b)). No invertibility or Tor restriction on K is used.

proof.text: Use the published projectionMapOfCompactification natural transformation. Assemble the source and target natural isomorphisms from finiteSupport, finitePullback, the coefficient equivalence units, and tensor currying. Their components agree with sourceComparison and targetComparison.

Whisker the published projection by inverse coefficient realization on both inputs and realization on the output; conjugate by the source and target isomorphisms. Evaluate NatTrans.naturality at (a,b), identify its components with component, and reflect through the faithful full constructible inclusion.

theorem component_input_naturality (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    {K K' : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X}
    {L L' : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left}
    (a : K ⟶ K') (b : L ⟶ L') :
    ((partialTensor S Y).map ((S.finite.support f c).map a)).app L ≫
        ((partialTensor S Y).obj ((S.finite.support f c).obj K')).map b ≫
        component S f c K' L' =
      component S f c K L ≫ (S.finite.support f c).map
        (((partialTensor S X).map a).app ((torPull S f).obj L) ≫
          ((partialTensor S X).obj K').map ((torPull S f).map b))
